category_edits.rationale: Across all four category models, lower Adam learning rate to 5e-4 and dropout to 0.08 together: smaller updates may stabilize optimization while reduced dropout preserves context signal in short histories. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor loading remain compatible. Preserve all other settings, masked-item loss, backbone, seeds and training limits.

change_summary: Jointly set shared learning rate to 5e-4 and dropout to 0.08 for the four independent BERT4Rec category models.
